author: Brandon Furtwangler
message: I was thinking about this today...I wonder if you could get even better performance by adding a 'compile' method, similar to how some RegEx libraries do. This would take a whole chain of lazy operations and produce a single optimized version (using eval/Function constructor), that inlines all of the operations. This would obviously have greater startup cost, but is a one time thing, and for large datasets or deep pipelines it could reduce the overhead associated with each element going through several layers of wrappers.
